summary.en: Boulevard City's indoor arena (after Kingdom Arena, Riyadh): beige panelled walls over a dark glazed base, a raised white roof over the pitch; the glazing glows warm at night. 47 m tall at full size; the height scales the whole building.
summary.ar: صالة بوليفارد سيتي المغلقة (على غرار المملكة أرينا بالرياض): جدران بألواح بيج فوق قاعدة زجاجية داكنة وسقف أبيض مرتفع فوق الملعب، ويتوهج الزجاج ليلاً. ارتفاعها 47 م بالحجم الكامل، والارتفاع يغيّر حجم المبنى كله.

defaults.note: height: kingdom-arena.report.json height_m 47.0, footprint frame 224.6 x 169.1 m (the file's box is 235.6 x 263.6 m: the footprint is turned in the map frame). The runtime scales each instance by height / 47, and the collider with it. cladding: the mean of arena.js's two panel tones (0.56, 0.45, 0.31) and (0.66, 0.55, 0.40). glow multiplies arena.js's night emission (glazing lit from inside, the base wash). Draws: arena.js draws one mesh per material (4); here arena.glb is models/kingdom-arena.glb with its four primitives joined by tools/glb-join.mjs (vertex data unchanged; the part was already baked in the vertex colour alpha by src/arena.py) and one preset branching on the part, so 1 draw per preset. lod1 is the same file as lod0 (no lighter version is made: the model is 3,762 triangles). Shadows on High, as buildArena's `cast`.
